The amount of questions that are asked is overwhelming for someone who is already stressed. Whoever came up with this idea definitely wants the NHS to fail. Looks like all GPs have been let go and the practice is being run by nurses. If you are lucky to get through the Anima, the most you will get is an appointment with a nurse.
